title: Society Wives — Flirting Style Reference
purpose: Dialogue-first, grown-up double-entendre flirting with a memory-loop seed, without presuming later romantic consent or changing plot authority.

characterVoices.rohan: 34; Shivani's husband; social, cheeky and expressive; black fitted sports tee suggestion
characterVoices.nikhil: 35; Meenakshi's husband; observant, calm, dry wit; midnight-blue sleeveless performance top suggestion
characterVoices.ankita: 30; confident and witty, shy for a beat then reclaims agency; neither outfit promise nor implied affair

continuity: Both men are married adults, not boys.
A02 takes place on Gulmohar Heights walking track at 06:20–06:37.
Ankita remains in her fitted athletic jacket and running tights during A02.
No weather change, removing jacket, touch, proposal, or implied mutual affair.
Rumor is a joke about hypothetical society gossip; nobody actually circulates gossip.
Do not imply reader-only thoughts are known to other characters.
Flirting style is a writer reference; the master plot remains the authority.
No A03 prose is approved or written by this reference.

draftDialogue.speaker: Rohan
draftDialogue.text: Ek din jacket ke bina black fitted sports tee mein walk karna. Phir dekhna, society ki morning attendance double ho jayegi.

draftDialogue.speaker: Ankita
draftDialogue.text: Achha ji? Fitness advice de rahe ho ya mere kapdon par research kar rahe ho?

draftDialogue.speaker: Nikhil
draftDialogue.text: Meri choice alag hai—midnight-blue sleeveless performance top. Tumhari shoulder definition aur posture clearly dikhega. You've worked for that fitness.

draftDialogue.speaker: Rohan
draftDialogue.text: Dekha, Ankita? Dono agree karte hain ki jacket ke bina look impressive hoga.

draftDialogue.speaker: Ankita
draftDialogue.text: Wah! Ek fashion critic, ek fitness auditor. Dono married gentlemen hain, zara yaad rahe!

draftDialogue.speaker: Nikhil
draftDialogue.text: Bilkul yaad hai. Aur Rohan ko toh apni running se zyada tumhari jacket mein interest lag raha hai.

draftDialogue.speaker: Rohan
draftDialogue.text: Arre, main toh bas soch raha tha—kal society mein rumor na fail jaaye ki morning walkers fitness se zyada fashion ke liye aa rahe hain.

draftDialogue.speaker: Ankita
draftDialogue.text: Jacket meri hai, suspense tum dono ka.

staging: Ankita touches her jacket zipper, briefly catches her lower lip, feels a moment of pleased self-consciousness, and departs toward the exercise corner without changing clothes.
memoryLoop: Jacket meri hai, suspense tum dono ka.

narratorVisualDescription.origin: Reference technique from original Dhika EP03 (Chotu Babu intro): the narrator describes an apple-like silhouette in motion during a walk while another character notices it. This is narrator imagery, not a line spoken by the observing character.
narratorVisualDescription.appliesTo: All adult female characters in Society Wives, when scene-appropriate and approved by the author
methods: outfit fit, drape and fabric movement
standing stance, turn, weight shift and dance pose
narrator-only private observation distinct from spoken flirt
examplePhrases: apple-rounded silhouette with a gentle sway as she walked
athletic, sculpted outline and confident stride
hourglass line defined by tailored clothing
elegant shoulder-to-waist taper as she turned
a confident stance as she shifted her weight
useInstructions: Use specific, vivid, varied narrator descriptions rather than generic words such as beautiful, hot, curvy or sexy alone.
Link comparison to the action: walking vs standing vs turning vs dancing may reveal different visual details.
Show the relevant person's clothes, posture, movement and scene geometry; do not assume a figure description is a spoken compliment.
Distinguish narrator visual description, one person's caught glance, aloud joke and the woman's own awareness or reaction; do not merge those viewpoints.
Write distinct descriptions for Ankita, Sana, Aishwarya and other adult women; do not reuse the same apple metaphor mechanically across everyone.
If body shape/outfit has not been established, treat comparisons as optional proposal—not fixed character canon. Get author's direction before locking.
Keep all source-approved flirt, reaction and visual seeds; never quietly drop a user-specified beat. If something conflicts with canon, flag and ask before rewriting.
A glance, a smile, playful banter, accidental balancing contact and mutual interest are different narrative events; do not automatically infer any one from another.
Avoid gratuitous intrusion, underage sexualization, or sexualized family relationships. Any adult characters' boundaries and character reactions remain source-grounded.
